 SELECT c.name AS company,
    c.funding_limit,
    COALESCE(ap.approved, (0)::numeric) AS approved,
    COALESCE(k.contracted, (0)::numeric) AS contracted,
    (c.funding_limit - COALESCE(k.contracted, (0)::numeric)) AS remaining
   FROM ((api.company c
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT application.company_id,
            sum(application.amount) AS approved
           FROM api.application
          WHERE (application.status_id = priv.status_id('Одобрена'::text))
          GROUP BY application.company_id) ap ON ((ap.company_id = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.company_id,
            sum(k_1.amount) AS contracted
           FROM (api.contract k_1
             JOIN api.application a ON ((a.id = k_1.application_id)))
          GROUP BY a.company_id) k ON ((k.company_id = c.id)));

args.query: select c.name,k.number,k.amount,k.status from api.contract k join api.application a on a.id=k.application_id join api.company c on c.id=a.company_id order by 1;
